content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures asphalt plants and road equipment for road builders and quarries, not downhole drilling tools for oilfields."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Builds roads and bridges for public owners using its own asphalt and aggregates; a construction business, not oilfield tools."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Reservoir analysis, lab testing and perforating systems; a reservoir services business rather than drilling tool rental and sales."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Distributes MRO and pump products to industrial plants; no downhole tools or oilfield tool rental."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Plumbing, HVAC and waterworks distributor serving contractors and municipalities; unrelated to oilfield drilling tools."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Artificial lift and production equipment rental for producing wells; shares onshore customers but not drilling tools."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Diversified industrial manufacturer of pumps, valves, brake pads and connectors; not downhole drilling tool rental."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Midstream gathering, processing and pipelines earning transport fees; a different business from drilling tool rental."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Rents and fabricates natural gas compressors for producers; equipment rental, but not drilling tools."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Mines frac sand and runs proppant logistics; a completion-stage materials business, not drilling tools."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Rents mobile power generation and sand handling equipment, increasingly to data centers; different equipment and end use."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Rents and sells downhole drilling tools to operators and performs drilling services onshore and globally; broader scope but same core tools."}]}
